race.description: Pelican Waters Resort 0 To 2 Win Trotters Hcp
race.comment: BLACK VIPER (6) finished fourth last start, beaten 4.5 metres at Albion Park over 2138m. Good enough to be right in the finish. LOCHINVAR SON (5) has been close to the mark of late and again performed impressively last time out, making up plenty of ground but finding a couple better over 2138m at Albion Park. Meets a comparable field so he can keep the ball rolling. SMOKEY BEAR (4) comes right into contention after scoring last start by 1.2 metres at Albion Park over 2138m. PROPELLED PRINCESS (1) is in the mix after turning in a better effort last start to finish second at Albion Park over 2138m.
